topBar.title: BrainDump
sidebar.dumpInputsAria: Text dump, photo capture, and coach
trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Restore items to your workspace, or delete them forever. Items you remove from lists appear here.
trash.deleteForeverConfirm: Permanently delete this item? This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyTrashConfirm: Permanently delete all {count} items in trash? This cannot be undone.
items.moveToTrashConfirm: Move this item to trash? You can restore it from Trash in the sidebar.
habitReminder.title: BrainDump reminders
habitReminder.intro: Get a gentle nudge to capture a dump on the days and times you choose. Notifications appear when this tab or app is open in your browser.
habitReminder.permissionDenied: Browser notifications are blocked. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings to see reminders.
habitReminder.permissionDefault: You may be asked to allow notifications the first time you turn reminders on.
habitReminder.notificationBody: Capture a quick dump while it is on your mind.
streaks.title: Dump streaks
streaks.intro: Build a streak by organizing at least one dump per day. Your current streak counts consecutive days with a completed organize + save.
streaks.levelProgressAria: Progress to next level: {current} of {need} dumps in this level
gamification.title: Momentum
gamification.intro: Two separate tracks: every new dump you capture earns capture XP, and every task you check off earns task XP. Levels unlock warmer titles—keep going.
gamification.progressAria: Progress in this level: {current} of {need} XP
gamification.signInHint: Sign in to sync levels and XP across devices.
gamification.feedback.dump.a: Nice capture — your future self will thank you.
gamification.feedback.dump.b: That’s another dump in the bank. Keep the signal coming.
gamification.feedback.dump.c: You showed up and spoke it out loud. That counts.
gamification.feedback.task.b: One less open loop. You’re stacking wins.
auth.signInPrompt: Sign in to keep your dumps, projects and organized items private to your account.
auth.valueCapture: Capture thoughts by voice, text, or photo — AI sorts them for you.
auth.valueOrganize: Work and personal spaces with projects, areas, and smart views.
auth.valueToday: Start each day with Today — see what matters now.
auth.gateNavAria: Sign in, create account, and social sign-in
auth.providerNotConfigured: This sign-in method is not configured on this server.
auth.cookieNote: Use a secure cookie-based session (up to 30 days with "Remember me").
auth.registrationSubtitle: Register with your name, email and a password.
auth.errorPasswordMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.accountCreatedBody: You can now sign in with your email and password.
today.title: Today
today.hint: Scroll up for past days, down for upcoming. Tap an item to open its workspace.
today.empty: Nothing scheduled for today. You’re clear, or add dates in the main workspace.
coach.title: Coach
coach.subtitle: Your tasks, notes, and reflections are in context — ask anything or use voice.
coach.emptyHint: Ask for help prioritizing, reflecting, or planning. Tap the mic to speak; your message is transcribed before sending.
coach.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
coach.transcribeFailed: Could not transcribe audio. Try again.
coach.sendFailed: Could not reach the coach. Try again.
scope.deleteProjectBody: and all its tasks, notes, and other items will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
scope.dateFilterQuickAria: Quick due date: no filtering, today, tomorrow, this week
scope.dateFilterMoreAria: More date filters (any date, no date)
center.allowMic: Allow microphone access to use your device's microphone.
center.transcriptPlaceholder: Recording transcript will appear here after Transcribe. You can also paste or type.
center.reflectionHelpIntro: Use these prompts to get a clearer brain dump before organizing.
center.dumpEmptyHint: Capture what's on your mind — record, type, or snap a photo.
center.organizedReview: Organized into {n} item(s). Review and save on the right.
center.organizeNetworkError: Organization failed. Your text is saved — tap Organize again to retry.
center.dumpPromptInbox: Start a recording, then use Stop to transcribe. For a photo or text dump, use the sidebar menu.
center.recordingMaxLength: Maximum recording length (5 minutes) reached — recording stopped. You can transcribe or record again.
error.openaiKey: OpenAI API key is not configured
error.noTextInImage: No readable text was found in the image. Try a clearer photo.
error.recordFirst: Record audio first, then click Transcribe.
error.emptyRecording: Recording is empty. Record again and wait a few seconds before stopping.
error.audioTooLarge: This audio clip is too large to send in one piece. Try a shorter recording or update the app so it can split long takes automatically.
error.noAudio: No audio was captured. Check that the microphone is working and not muted, then try again.
error.enterTranscript: Enter or paste a transcript, then click Organize.
items.emptyFilters: No items match the current filters.
items.textViewSplitHint: Tip: A blank line between paragraphs creates a new entry. With entry titles on, the first line of each paragraph is the headline; the rest is the description.
items.textViewTapMoreDetails: Tap to add or edit details (blank line starts a new entry)
items.typeNewHint: Last entries from your latest organized dump
items.suggestError: Could not load suggestions. The server may be missing OPENAI_API_KEY.
items.aiNextThreeTitle: Coach suggestions — clear your mind, focus on what matters, find relief
items.aiNextThreeEmpty: No suggestions right now. Add more entries or try again later.
items.calendarSwipeHint: Swipe the dates row left or right to change week.
items.mobileSimplifiedNote: On mobile, list and calendar views are optimized. Kanban and post-its are available on desktop.
items.kanbanNote: Kanban shows tasks in two columns: to do and completed. Other entry types appear in List or Post-its.
items.flowchartEmpty: No items yet. Add dumps and organize to see your mind map.
items.headline: Headline
items.notifyMinutesBefore: Also notify this many minutes before
items.confirmDeleteEntry: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
items.editTapToSchedule: Tap to add date and time
settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAllIntro: Permanently remove selected organized entries: completed tasks, reflections, or shopping items. Open the list to choose a scope.
settings.deleteAllConfirm: Permanently delete all your organized entries? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAllError: Could not delete entries. Try again.
settings.deleteWorkConfirm: Permanently delete all organized entries in Work? This cannot be undone.
settings.deletePersonalConfirm: Permanently delete all organized entries in Personal? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteEntriesOverlayIntro: Pick exactly one option below. Only organized entries in that category are removed — this does not delete your account or API keys.
settings.deleteEntriesEmpty: You have no entries to delete.
settings.deleteEntriesNoEntriesButEmptyP: You have no organized entries. You can still remove empty projects (sidebar names with no items) below.
settings.deleteEntriesSelectFirst: Select an option in the list first.
settings.deleteEmptyProjectsHint: You have {count} project(s) in the sidebar with no entries. Remove them if you no longer need those names.
settings.deleteEmptyProjectsConfirm: Permanently delete {count} project(s) that have no entries? They will disappear from the project list. This cannot be undone.
settings.showEntryTitlesHelp: When off, list, text, kanban, calendar, post-its, and mind map show description (or a snippet) instead of the title. Stored in your browser only.
settings.showDumpFaceHelp: Simple animated face above the dump panel while you record and organize. Turn off if you prefer a minimal UI. Stored in your browser only.
settings.soundEffectsHelp: When on, checking off a task plays a crowd cheer from Pixabay (People crowd cheers — royalty-free: https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/people-crowd-cheers-314919/). Stored in your browser only.
settings.privacyHelp: How BrainDump stores data and uses AI. Opens in a new tab.
profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your name and photo appear in the sidebar and on your profile page.
profile.imageHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF. Small files work best (under ~320 KB).
profile.badImageType: Use an image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF).
profile.deleteAccountHelp: Permanently delete your account and all dumps, items, and projects. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete your BrainDump account and all data? You will be signed out. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteAccountError: Could not delete account. Try again.
revenueCat.statusPro: You have an active Pro subscription. Thank you for supporting the app.
revenueCat.statusFree: Unlock Pro for the full experience. Monthly, yearly, and lifetime plans are available.
revenueCat.footerHint: Purchases use RevenueCat Web Billing. Use “Manage subscription” for billing portal or Customer Center links when available.
revenueCat.devMissingKey: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_API_KEY in .env.local to enable subscriptions (Web Billing public key from RevenueCat).
settings.googleCalendarHelp: After you connect and pick a calendar, use “Import into BrainDump” to copy events into BrainDump’s Calendar view. Nothing is imported automatically.
settings.googleCalendarOAuthNotConfigure: Google Calendar sign-in is not set up on this deployment. Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (and matching OAuth redirect URIs) to the server environment.
settings.googleCalendarImportError: Import failed. Try connecting again if your Google session expired.
settings.googleCalendarNoToken: Connect Google Calendar first (use the button above), then import.
settings.googleCalendarNoCalendar: Choose which Google calendar to read from, then import.
settings.calendarImportTargetNote: Imports are saved as Personal › thoughts (calendar entries). You can move them afterward.
settings.appleCalendarIntro: Websites cannot open Apple Calendar directly. Export a calendar or selection as an .ics file, then import it below. In the BrainDump iPhone/iPad app, use “Import from Apple Calendar” for a one-tap read from your device (no file).
settings.appleCalendarIntroIosNative: Imports events visible on this device (past 3 months and next 12 months) from calendars you have in Apple Calendar. Grant access when iOS asks—imports only run when you tap the button below.
settings.appleCalendarImportNativeDone: Imported {count} events from Apple Calendar into BrainDump.
settings.appleCalendarImportNativeError: Could not read your calendars. Try again or use Settings › BrainDump to check Calendar access.
settings.appleCalendarPermissionDenied: Calendar access was denied. You can enable it in Settings › BrainDump › Calendars.
settings.appleCalendarIcsHelp: On Mac: Calendar → select calendar or events → File → Export → Export…. On iPhone/iPad: use a share/export option from an app that produces an .ics file, or export from iCloud.com. Then choose the file here.
settings.appleCalendarExportStepMac: Mac: File → Export, or drag events to the Desktop to create .ics files.
settings.appleCalendarExportStepIos: iPhone/iPad: sharing options vary by OS version; iCloud.com (Calendar) can export calendars on the web.
settings.appleCalendarImportDone: Imported {count} events from the file into BrainDump.
settings.appleCalendarImportError: Could not read that file. Check that it is a valid .ics calendar export.
settings.appleCalendarIcloudNote: BrainDump cannot log in to iCloud Calendar directly in the browser. The .ics import path works with exports from Apple Calendar, iCloud, or other apps.

unclear.body: We weren't sure where these belong. Pick work or personal and what kind of thing each is.
unclear.questionKind: What kind of thing is it?
welcome.subtitleLanguage: Choose your language. You can change it anytime in settings.
welcome.subtitleHow: Three steps to a clearer mind.
welcome.subtitleReady: Start with Today or capture your first dump.
welcome.flow1: Capture — speak, type, or photograph what's on your mind.
welcome.flow2: Organize — AI turns your dump into tasks, notes, and events.
welcome.flow3: Act — use Today and your workspaces to focus on what matters.
welcome.readyNote: We'll open Today so you can see what's due and capture when you're ready.
help.q1: How are you feeling right now?
help.q2: What is the most important thing you need to do next?
help.q3: Is there anything you have been avoiding?
help.q4: What unfinished task is taking up mental space?
help.q5: What would make today feel successful?
help.q6: Is there a small step you can take in the next 10 minutes?
help.q7: What can you delegate, defer, or delete?
help.q8: Is there anything you need to communicate to someone?
help.q9: What are you grateful for in this moment?
help.q10: What do you want to remember from this brain dump?
